readings.moment: When the temple struck nine, at the start of dinner
The hall clock downstairs struck ten
When the hall clock struck ten, the regulator showed twelve minutes to ten
When the temple struck ten, the regulator agreed with the bell exactly
When he sent her downstairs from the bench
When Madame's piano began, Rosa's clock showed two minutes to eleven
When the piano stopped, Rosa's clock showed eleven minutes past eleven
The temple struck eleven, and Lina was still in the kitchen with Rosa until after it struck

durations: Four years spent on the repeater
About 13 minutes of piano playing, from 10:58 (piano began) to 11:11 (piano stopped), by Rosa's clock
whereabouts: At dinner, Monnier made everyone show their watches when the temple struck nine
Lina went up to the atelier after dinner to work beside Monnier
Monnier sent Lina away from the bench when the regulator showed 10:20
Lina went straight down to the kitchen after leaving the atelier
Lina was in the kitchen with Rosa when Madame's piano began
Madame was playing the piano from about 10:58 until about 11:11
Lina stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven
